# CANDIDATE: VIX_MORNING_FILTER_FOR_BEAR_PUTS

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a VIX morning filter (VIX >= 18 and rising) to BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON PUT entries will avoid the losing PUT days (5/05, 5/06) while preserving the three winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04). The filter targets periods of elevated fear and upward VIX momentum, which historically align with strong bearish moves.

## Mechanism

For BEAR PUT entries triggered by BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON, require that the 5-minute VIX at the entry bar is >= 18.0 and strictly greater than the VIX value of the prior 5-minute bar. If the condition fails, suppress the entry. All other entry/exit logic remains unchanged.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** Proposed filter would be evaluated on the same 16-month SPY 5m dataset (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) used for existing candidates; risk of overfit due to tuning VIX threshold on historical loser days.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA fill validation on top 3 J days not yet performed).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: filter could suppress a winner if VIX condition fails (e.g., 4/29 VIX <18 or flat). Max drawdown: potential increase if filter causes missed winners and larger losers. Blow-up scenario: persistent VIX >=18 regime leads to overtrading and cumulative losses if edge deteriorates.
6. **Concentration:** If top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute concentration.
